name: the-tavern
description: The Tavern: hire an AI crew for your quest. Fifteen Claude Code plugins that work alone or as a party.

plugins.name: sage
plugins.description: Turns a feature idea into a sealed spec. Reads the codebase first, asks only what the code cannot answer, then writes numbered requirements with acceptance criteria that can fail and a cited source for each. A validator checks the spec and seals it with a hash. Plans only, never writes code.

plugins.name: smith
plugins.description: Builds a spec to its requirements. Splits it into slices with explicit file ownership, builds independent slices in parallel, then has verifiers that never saw the builders' notes check every requirement and record the evidence. Fixes and re-verifies until everything passes or a limit is hit.

plugins.name: warden
plugins.description: Stops Claude racing on everyday work. Injects a short checklist before each reply, then blocks replies that cite files Claude never opened, hedge without checking, or promise work instead of doing it.

plugins.name: sellsword
plugins.description: Hand it a gnarly problem and it owns the outcome. Five agents investigate, plan, execute and verify across code, servers and infrastructure, with two independent verifiers that must both pass before it stops.

plugins.name: cleric
plugins.description: Careful codebase cleanup across seven tracks: duplication, dead code, weak types, circular dependencies, error handling and AI leftovers. Auto-applies only high-confidence changes, one revertable commit at a time.

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: Writes Playwright end-to-end tests by driving your real app in a browser instead of guessing selectors from source. Discovers routes, builds role-based suites, and triages failures from traces.

plugins.name: tactician
plugins.description: Generates multi-agent Workflow orchestration scripts on demand. Picks the right fan-out shape for the task and hands you a validated script you own and can edit.

plugins.name: seer
plugins.description: Senior-engineer architecture review: is this shaped right, or did it just accrete? Eight blind design lenses, every finding cross-examined to drop the intentional ones, then a concrete reshaping plan. Report only.

plugins.name: ranger
plugins.description: Give it one brief and walk away. A self-directing loop that finds work, sizes the effort to the job, plans and reviews in parallel, builds one item at a time, verifies with fresh eyes, and commits — until you stop it. Local commits only.

plugins.name: tinker
plugins.description: Builds a spec lean, in about an hour. One builder that must run the integration check and read the result, then a code check beside one spec-to-code checker, and at most two batched fix rounds whose tests fail before and pass after. Three agents and a capped, counted number of agent calls.

plugins.name: squire
plugins.description: A compact build, verify and fix loop for a small spec that already has requirement IDs and acceptance criteria. One test-first builder, a verifier that sees only the spec and the code and cites file:line for every verdict, a fixer limited to the listed gaps, and drift checks in code. Loops until clean or three fix rounds, then reports.

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Writes and audits documentation for an application you built. /scribe:plan surveys the repository and proposes an overview, getting-started tutorial, how-to guides, reference and explanation pages plus a docs layout. /scribe:write writes the pages with every claim anchored to a file:line or a command that was run, then has a reader who knows nothing about the code report where each page loses them. /scribe:audit runs link, anchor, evidence, stale-command, reader and jargon gates over existing docs and returns a ranked punch list.

plugins.name: bard
plugins.description: An experiential UX review of a running web app. Uses the app in a real browser through Playwright MCP as named personas (first-time, power user, keyboard-only, mobile, low vision, or your own), one area at a time, across seven review lenses. Screenshots every defect, reads the console and network for silent failures, and writes a ranked report where every finding has steps to reproduce, a screenshot, a severity and a suggested fix.

plugins.name: monk
plugins.description: Keeps replies short and useful. Loads a seven-rule ruleset at session start (answer first, numbered steps, one next action, no preamble or sign-off, real time units, flat tone on failure, lists of five or fewer) and a one-line reminder on every prompt. An optional length gate sends an over-budget reply back once with instructions to shorten it. State is per session.

plugins.name: raven
plugins.description: Posts Claude Code session events to Slack. When a reply finishes or Claude Code needs your attention, raven sends a colour-coded message to an incoming webhook with the prompt's first line, the opening of the reply, the folder, the git branch and the session id. Secrets are redacted before sending, repeats are suppressed, and a missing webhook or a Slack error is logged without ever blocking Claude.
